Title: `reportcompany` refuses a missing or malformed token
Steps: 1. POST `reportcompany` with no Authorization header 2. repeat with `Bearer not-a-jwt`
Expected result: both refused (HTTP 401/403, or HTTP 200 with `status` 0) and no data returned
